dynamic_controls: <button class="tile-action-btn" style="color:var(--gmeet-primary);" title="Remote Control & Assist Client" onclick="openRemoteControlModal(${escapeJsString(clientId)}, ${escapeJsString(clientName)})" aria-label="Remote Control & Assist Client">
<button class="tile-action-btn" title="Capture Snapshot Evidence" onclick="captureClientSnapshot(${escapeJsString(clientId)}, ${escapeJsString(clientName)})" aria-label="Capture Snapshot Evidence">
<button class="tile-action-btn" title="Spotlight / Pin" onclick="togglePin('tile-${clientId}')" aria-label="Spotlight / Pin">
<button class="tile-action-btn" title="Mute Participant" onclick="remoteMuteClient('${clientId}')" aria-label="Mute Participant">

<button class="tile-action-btn" style="color:var(--gmeet-red);" title="Remove Participant" onclick="remoteKickClient(${escapeJsString(clientId)}, ${escapeJsString(clientName)})" aria-label="Remove Participant">
<button class="p-action-btn" title="Pin to screen" onclick="togglePin(${escapeJsString(`tile-${u.id}`)})" aria-label="Pin to screen">
<button class="p-action-btn danger" title="Remove from call" onclick="remoteKickClient(${escapeJsString(u.id)}, ${escapeJsString(u.name)})" aria-label="Remove from call">
<button class="btn-gmeet btn-gmeet-outline" style="font-size:11px; padding:3px 8px; color:var(--gmeet-red); border-color:rgba(234, 67, 53, 0.4);" onclick="endPoll()" aria-label="End poll">
